app_type: Enterprise SaaS Video Analytics Platform / Command Center

headings.strategy: Wide, geometric, tactical. Represents precision and high-tech command center. Tracking tight (-0.02em).

body.strategy: Highly legible in dense data tables and logs.

data_and_metrics.strategy: Mandatory for all live data: FPS, CPU usage, inference time, coordinates, time stamps.

typography.guidelines: NEVER use Space Grotesk. Use Outfit for all headers. Always apply tracking-tight to H1/H2. Line height tight for headers, relaxed for body.

surfaces.glassmorphism: Use 'Crystal Glass' for Top Navigation and Sidebar. Class: `bg-zinc-950/60 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-r border-white/10`. DO NOT use transparent backgrounds without blur.
surfaces.neumorphism_tactical: Use flat, technical surfaces for Dashboard Cards. Class: `bg-zinc-900 border border-white/5`. Do NOT use soft shadows; use 1px inner strokes.
surfaces.grid_borders: For the multi-camera grid view, expose the skeleton using `border-collapse` style gaps with `border border-white/10` to look technical and precise.

visual_enhancers.overlays: AI bounding boxes (person, car) on camera feeds must use vibrant 1px borders (Red/Green/Yellow) with a very faint transparent fill (e.g., `bg-red-500/20`).

grids_and_layouts.strategy: High Density Grid (Bento Mode B). Every pixel must be utilized. No jagged bottoms.
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Tight gaps (`gap-4` or `gap-6`) between cards. Internal padding for cards should be `p-4` to `p-6`.
grids_and_layouts.structure: Sidebar + Top Nav layout. Sidebar must have a solid or glass background. Main content area must have `min-h-screen bg-zinc-950 text-white p-6`.
grids_and_layouts.dashboard_grid: `grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4`. Main camera feed spans `col-span-2 row-span-2` or `col-span-3`. Stats widgets span `col-span-1`.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped or sharp rectangular. Interaction animations required. Primary buttons: `bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 text-white transition-colors duration-200`.
components.cards: Borderless or subtle 1px border. `bg-zinc-900 rounded-lg border border-white/5 overflow-hidden`. Do not overuse heavy shadows.
components.forms_and_inputs: Shadcn/UI inputs. Background `bg-zinc-950`, border `border-zinc-800`. Focus state: `focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:border-transparent`.
components.canvas_drawable: For 'restricted zones', implement an HTML5 Canvas over the video feed with custom crosshair cursor and drawing logic. Stroke color: Red.
components.charts: Use Recharts. Ensure tooltips have dark backgrounds (`bg-zinc-900 border-zinc-800`). Use Accent Primary for primary metric lines, Warning/Critical for threshold indicators.
components.toasts: Use `sonner` located in `/app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx`. Dark theme standard.
components.icons: Use `@phosphor-icons/react`. Sizing: 20px-24px for navigation, 16px for inline data.

motion.live_indicators: Red recording/live dot must have a soft `animate-pulse` effect.
motion.hover_states: Cards should have slight lift (`-translate-y-[1px]`) and border color brightening (`hover:border-white/20`).
motion.page_transitions: Fade in on load. Staggered entrance for list items in Event Log (e.g., `animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-bottom-4`).
motion.loading: Skeleton loaders for camera feeds and charts. Class: `animate-pulse bg-zinc-800`.

media_and_images.strategy: Use realistic enterprise camera feed placeholders. Never use empty placeholder text.

accessibility.contrast: Text below 18px must be min 4.5:1. Use `#FFFFFF` for primary text, `#A1A1AA` for secondary. Avoid `#52525B` for anything other than disabled states.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements MUST have visible focus rings (`focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500`).
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="live-feed-camera-1"`).

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Prioritize using .js (JavaScript) and .jsx extensions instead of .tsx for this project.
Do NOT center align the app container; do not use `.App { text-align: center; }`.
Install required dependencies: `yarn add @phosphor-icons/react recharts sonner`.
Use Shadcn UI components where applicable, customizing them to fit the 'Neumorphism Tactical' styling. Override default radii to be sharper (`rounded-md` instead of `rounded-xl`).
Use Tailwind CSS for styling exclusively. Avoid inline styles.
Never use generic placeholder image URLs (like via.placeholder.com). Use the provided image URLs in `media_and_images`.
Build empty states for lists/logs using dashed borders and muted icons to reflect the enterprise tactical feel.
Do not use universal transitions (`transition-all`). Target specific properties like `transition-colors`, `transition-opacity`.
DO NOT use a fully transparent background for the top navigation or sidebar dropdowns. Ensure they have `bg-zinc-900` or `bg-zinc-950/80 backdrop-blur-md`.

instructions_to_main_agent.step_1: Setup global CSS. Define base Tailwind config with Obsidian, Volt Blue, and Warning/Critical colors.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_2: Implement layout scaffolding: Glassmorphism Sidebar, Top Navigation with user profile, and Main content area.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_3: Build Dashboard view: Include Recharts for hourly detections, a large primary video feed component with bounding box overlays, and smaller grid feeds.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_4: Develop Live Monitoring & Canvas: Implement a canvas layer over a selected camera feed to allow the user to draw polygonal restricted zones.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_5: Create AI Settings Panel: Sliders for Confidence Threshold, IoU, and toggles for detection classes (Person, Car, etc).
instructions_to_main_agent.step_6: Populate with data and ensure all `data-testid` attributes are in place.
